scope: Very small calibration sample diagnostic: fixed INT4 up projections only. Not research adoption.
projection: up half of original fused gate_up_proj; original upper-half output of F.linear is identity reference
data_limitations: Old evaluation documents reused from a different study, not fresh blind data. Expert weights/distributions differ, so expert differences are not causal sample-size effects.

format.rounding: torch.round ties-to-even before adding zero point

hessian: FP32 H=2*X.T@X/N, fit routed tokens only. TF32 disabled.
candidate_isolation: Every call starts with separate W.clone and H.clone. Original byte hashes checked after every candidate. No candidate consumes previous modified inputs.

aliases.coverage_0.5_percent: All fit counts exceed 10.24: eligible for GPTQ; paired with fixed gptq_0.01 for main alias table, not a fifth distinct policy. Other dampings similarly alias fixed GPTQ.
aliases.coverage_plus_2K: All fit counts below 4096: identical to fixed RTN.

selection.score: sum FP64 squared projection error over all routed elements; common denominator across policies

validation.cpu: Independent tiny NumPy sequential GPTQ including rank-deficient/dead-column case, reversed candidate order, independent nibble unpacking. Not real model candidates.
validation.identity: all 24 documents x 4 experts; original fused BF16 up output vs separate unquantized up; exact bytes
validation.packing: all real candidate codes roundtrip; FP32 decode equals primitive output bytes

decision.primary: expert_direct vs common_direct, fixed_rtn and fixed_gptq_0.01
decision.scope: Projection-level selection benefit only; no full-model quality or novelty claim.
decision.stop: If common setting or direct selection suffices, close new-selector development. No actual deployment/calibration service budget is specified, so do not declare direct evaluation unaffordable.

cost_accounting.fixed_rtn: weight access + RTN generation/packing only; no Hessian or other candidate costs
cost_accounting.fixed_gptq: weight and fit-input access + H collection + one candidate generation/packing
cost_accounting.direct_common_and_expert: same candidate generation and choice FP64 evaluation pool; report selection reductions separately
cost_accounting.audit_and_evaluation: identity checks, hashes, extra native BF16 evaluations, heldout evaluation and archive I/O reported as diagnostic overhead
cost_accounting.memory: overall measured peak only; no full policy isolated memory comparison claimed
cost_accounting.timings: Single diagnostic execution with explicit synchronization; no speedup significance claim or cold-service latency extrapolation

failure_policy: No damping changes/retries and no silent RTN fallback. Record true failure, stop and investigate validity within cap; do not replace experts or extend candidate set.
